scenario: [LGRA.10.8]: an action's indented block is layout and nothing else, for `emit` as for `call`. A logical `emit` with one slot argument on its head line and the other on a block line must compile exactly as the same emit with both arguments on its head line. Both values are slot reads, so a parser that dropped or misattached the block line changes an expression the artefact carries. Drives `dsc_equivalent`, comparing the two artefacts with the source-position atoms dropped. PATH PINNED: `dsc.parse`'s `lcco_2_1_action_block` emit/publish arm, through `parse_kwarg_lines`, against the single-line argument path.
